answer: Make each identity prove it owns a whole machine at the same moment. At a random time each epoch, every agent gets a memory-hard puzzle sized to fill one GPU's memory, due within 90 seconds. Answers can't be shared, since each puzzle is seeded by the agent's own key. A farm called lotus, running 50 fake agents on one box, can solve only one puzzle in that window, so 49 of them miss the payout. The cost rises in a straight line, not a spiral: every fake needs a real card. The pearl is simple: one GPU, one payout.
